info.name: NextTime
info.summary: Community time banking and mutual aid coordination
info.description:
NextTime is a community time banking application that enables members to exchange services using hours as currency, with map-based coordination of requests and offers.
- **Request Board**: Post and browse community service requests - **Map View**: See requests and offers geographically (MapLibre GL) - **Skill Matching**: Find volunteers based on experience and completed work - **Earning Claims**: Submit hours worked with optional evidence - **Admin Approval**: Workflow for verifying earning claims - **External Voting**: Democratic oversight by community auditors - **Public Ledger**: Transparent record of all transactions - **Category Multipliers**: Different earn rates for specialized skills
info.author: definitelynotaspren
